scope: Test-only observation evidence, not a production repair or closure of prior CI failure. Original process calls/assertions/limits retained.
limits: Local pass validates instrumentation; it does not identify the earlier CI subtype or prove a fix.
Instrumentation adds bounded timing/metadata overhead under original deadlines.
Raw original exception arguments, text, output, PID, paths and traceback are not retained in diagnostic state.

additional_failure_visibility.scope: Only original/retired execution failure prints static case plus private_entry_seen boolean after existing cleanup. No original call, monitor, assertion or limit changed.
additional_failure_visibility.checks: 2 injected-before-fixture failures preserve exception identity and original monitoring slots; output has exactly case and false private_entry_seen. Scoped Ruff/format pass.
additional_failure_visibility.limitation: No new genuine-source acceptance claimed for these fault-plumbing checks.
